topic.title: Apple TV now costs $14.99 a month after its fourth price hike in four years
topic.summary: Apple raised the price of its streaming service for new and current subscribers on Friday, bumping it up from $12.99 per month to $14.99, Deadline and Variety are reporting. An annual subscription now costs $119, up from $99. Apple also increased the cost of its individual Apple One subscription, which includes Apple TV and Apple's […]

concept.topic_title: Apple TV now costs $14.99 a month after its fourth price hike in four years
concept.chosen_angle: Apple's 'affordable' streaming service just got a 200% price increase – here's the math that exposes the contradiction.
concept.core_claim: Apple markets Apple TV+ as an affordable service, but its price has tripled since launch, far outpacing inflation.
concept.viewer_problem: You might be paying $14.99 for a service that was once $4.99, and you need to know if it's still worth it.
concept.curiosity_gap: How much more are you paying compared to when it launched, and what does that actually get you?
concept.payoff: Apple TV+ has gone from $4.99 to $14.99 in four years – a 200% increase, while the content library hasn't even doubled.
risk_flags: needs clear visual of price timeline

all_angles.angle: The hidden reason Apple TV+ costs $14.99 isn't your favorite show – it's the billions Apple spent on sports.
all_angles.core_claim: Apple's price hike is driven by its massive sports deals (MLS, NFL Sunday Ticket) and the streaming arms race, not just original content.
all_angles.viewer_problem: You're paying for sports you may never watch, and that's why your bill went up.
all_angles.curiosity_gap: What exactly is Apple spending your subscription money on?
all_angles.payoff: Apple paid $2.5 billion for MLS rights and $2 billion for NFL Sunday Ticket – and they're passing that cost to you.

all_angles.angle: Apple TV+ just hit $14.99 – that's a 200% price jump since launch. Here's what that really means for your wallet.
all_angles.core_claim: The price increase is unprecedented compared to competitors and inflation, making Apple TV+ one of the most expensive streaming services.
all_angles.viewer_problem: You're paying more for a service that hasn't quadrupled in value, and you need to decide if it's worth keeping.
all_angles.curiosity_gap: How does $14.99 compare to Netflix, Disney+, and what you're actually getting?
all_angles.payoff: Apple TV+ now costs more than Netflix's standard plan with ads, yet has a fraction of the content library.

all_angles.angle: Your Apple One subscription just went up silently – here's how much extra you're paying without realizing it.
all_angles.core_claim: The price increase is hidden in Apple One bundles, so many users will see higher bills without a clear reason.
all_angles.viewer_problem: If you have Apple One, your monthly bill just increased, and you might not have noticed until now.
all_angles.curiosity_gap: How much more will you pay per year if you're on Apple One?
all_angles.payoff: Apple One individual went from $16.95 to $19.95 per month – that's an extra $36 per year for the same services.
risk_flags: needs to confirm exact bundle prices
might be too niche if not many use Apple One

script.hook: Apple TV+ just got a 200% price hike. Wait, wasn't it supposed to be affordable?

scenes.narration: Launched in 2019, Apple TV+ started at $4.99 a month.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of an iPhone screen showing the Apple TV+ app in 2019

scenes.narration: Today, the price is $14.99, a 200% increase in just four years.
scenes.visual_prompt: Split-screen comparison of the Apple TV+ pricing in 2019 and 2023

scenes.narration: This marks the fourth consecutive year Apple has raised the price.
scenes.visual_prompt: Animated graph showing the annual price increases of Apple TV+

scenes.narration: The Apple One bundle also got a price hike, now costing $19.95 a month.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of an iPad screen showing the Apple One bundle pricing

scenes.narration: So, what do you get for this premium price?
scenes.visual_prompt: Montage of popular Apple TV+ shows, with a question mark overlay

script.cta: With Apple TV+ now costing $14.99 per month, is the quality and quantity of content on the platform sufficient to justify this premium pricing?
script.title: The Real Reason Apple TV+ is No Longer Affordable
